goal: Unify agent-invocation across boards that declare dialogOrchestration: 'director' -- Domain/Realm uses DialogCastBar, IDE uses a different component (BoardInstrumentsBar), Designer uses BoardInstrumentsBar too. Same declared orchestration mode, two different implementations. Replace with one shared mechanism.
done_when: One shared component/pattern renders agent roster + invocation for every board declaring dialogOrchestration: 'director' (currently Domain/Realm via castBar:true, IDE and Designer via boardInstruments) -- do not keep two parallel implementations of the same concept

Cursor decides and documents which existing component wins (DialogCastBar extended to cover BoardInstrumentsBar's job, or vice versa, or a new shared component both delegate to) -- this is a real design decision, not a mechanical merge; document the reasoning in the commit message

The lead agent (directorAgentSlug) always renders distinctly from invocable instruments in the unified component, on every board that uses it -- matching the existing distinction DialogCastBar already draws (lead chip vs support-agent chips)

Clicking an instrument still invokes it the same way it does today on each board (onInvokeAgent / activeBoardInstrumentSlug wiring preserved) -- this is a presentation unification, not a behavior change to which boards can invoke which agents
IDE, Designer, and Domain/Realm boards all visually read as the same underlying pattern afterward -- verified by comparing screenshots of each board's composer area, not just by reading the code
No change to which boards declare which instruments (IDE's ['cloud','rendr'], Designer's ['kip'], Domain's cast roster) -- this unifies the rendering, not the board-instrument assignments themselves
Manual check: /d/ke3p?board=realm, ?board=ide, and Designer board all show agent invocation through the same visual/interaction pattern

ke3p's real dialog/library data -- already consolidated and fixed this session, unrelated to this handoff

context.notes: Two other real findings from the same round were fixed directly by Cloud, not scoped as handoffs, because they were small and already fully diagnosed: (1) GET /api/library-items had no category filter, so the 78 archive-tagged LibraryItems from the ke3p consolidation were flooding Realm's Kept nav bucket unfiltered -- fixed by excluding category:archive by default (commit 6afa46b7), matching the includeArchived pattern already used for dialogs. (2) ke3p kept spawning new dialogs on every board visit because findOrCreateKipDialog's reuse lookup (domain+scope+user_id+board+frame) didn't match how 'Becoming Together' was originally created (user_id:null, available_to:['admin'], context board='realm'/frame='cover') -- real sessions use user_id:Chuck's id, available_to:['keeper'], context board='domain'/frame='conversation'. Fixed directly by updating Becoming Together's binding to match real usage and archiving the one duplicate dialog that had already spawned (verified empty, 0 messages, before archiving). Both fixes verified by direct query, not assumed. This handoff is the one remaining item that's genuinely bigger design work, not a quick patch -- do not rush a mechanical merge of the two components without deciding which pattern actually wins.
